note: PREREG-V3 plan step A3.d: the declared A3 fetch windows, fixed before any window runs. Every fetch is a child under the contract through the catch-mode proxy, whose catcher tunnels only a window's exact hosts through the declared hop (the auditor's O1 ruling). The a3-hf hosts come from the a3-discovery record d1 (P5, Q-A3-3); a redirect to an unlisted host is refused and needs a new ruling. D: must hold max(100 GB, 3 x the window's discovered total) free before a window; any single file over 10 GB in discovery stops the step (Q-A3-2). A pin whose repository or path is still undeclared is not fetched.
